insight: Founded in 2017 in Yerevan, Armenia by an ex-Twilio engineer; originally named 2Hz.
name: Krisp
tagline: On-device AI noise cancellation, transcription, and meeting notes.
description: Voice AI platform that removes background noise, transcribes calls, and generates meeting notes. It installs as a virtual microphone/speaker, so noise cancellation works across Zoom, Teams, Meet, and 800+ other apps without joining as a bot. Also offers accent conversion and a call-center product on the same engine.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary voice AI engine; noise cancellation processes audio on-device.

edge: On-device noise cancellation as a virtual mic works across 800+ apps without a meeting bot — leading clarity, fully local.
pros: Works across any app via virtual device
